column2: Hiya, hon. I'm Maebot, fashion consultant to the cosmos. What can we do with ya today?
Very lovely, honey, it's made for you. Would you like us to wrap it up, or would that 'special someone' prefer you to wear it home?
Just what we thought. That will be 60 buckazoids, sicko.
Are you sure you got the right store, hon?
Thanks for shopping at Sacks!
Appreciate it, hon.
Oh, it's you again. What do you want?
Well, okay, but don't try that again. If you have to be weird, fine, but we don't appreciate shoplifters, dear.
Oh, it's you again, would you stop wasting my time?
Are you in need of an auditory exam or what? Pay up, pal!
Let us know if we can help.
Oh, let me guess. You want something for someone very special, somebody who'd die to get the latest in high-galactic fashion.
Listen hon, I got work to do here. You run along now. Maybe you could bring back your girl sometime. Bye now.
Trying to weasel out of paying, huh?
Cut the chit chat and hand over the cash.
It really is nice weather, but then this is an artificial computer controlled climate. Now how about some cash?
I think you're cute too, but looks won't pay for those designer duds.
We don't haggle over prices here hon, either pay up or put the dress back!
I don't want to have to throw you out, but if you don't hand over the cash, I'll have no choice.

Stop wasting my time, you sickos are all the same, now pay up!
572	Listen, you twerp, the dress is 60 buckazoids, now hand over the cash or the dress!"
Are we right or are we right?
Okay, what size does she take?
Ooh, I don't think we're right about that.
Is she? A likely story. Good thing for you I can keep a secret, sweetie.
I'm sure this will suit that 'special someone's needs'. It's all the rage.
I suppose you'll want to try it on now. Here, use this dressing room.
And honey, if your 'special someone' needs a wig, this one should look pretty good on you.
As you change your clothes, you think to yourself that, even in drag, you still have incredible animal magnetism... or is that just a lack of deodorant?
Hey! Not bad for a robotic mannequin.
Despite your love for Synthoskin, you decide that wouldn't be gentlemanly.
Closet mannequin whiffer, eh?
Although it's just a robotic mannequin, it's not intelligent enough to converse with even you.
You like the shoes, but the stripes might make you look overweight.
It can't be real. You know you're an irresistable babe magnet.
OUCH! You almost got a sliver in your tongue!
Technosmell emanates from it.
Although just an animated mannequin, it's not intelligent enough to converse with even you.
Fringe! Would that be too daring?
Quickly changing your clothes, you emerge in your space guy wardrobe.
Keep your hands to yourself!
This doesn't look like your favorite flavor mannequin.
Yep. Smells robotic.
Don't bother. You don't need dummies making you look stupid, too!
You check out the clerk. Hmmmm...You've always had a thing for women with antennae.
Having already purchased the dress, you decide to stick with men's clothes from now on...even though it was almost TOO too enjoyable.
It is darn tempting, but you realize that duty calls and this will have to wait. Maybe you could cruise back by when the game is over.
It tastes like Tarnex! Well, at least your tongue is tarnish free.
Uhmm! The rich smell of robotic lubricants wafts through your smell buds.
It's a deep pile wig.
You're becoming a whiz at putting on women's clothing. In a flash you emerge looking tres chic. Could you be enjoying this just a little too much?
Nah. You'd rather not. You never know where it's been.
Whew!! From what type of beast was this rendered?
You lick the wig and almost immediately cough up a fur ball.
The latest in swank fashion displayed in a number of horrifying colors.
While enjoying this banquet o' fashion you wonder what you might look like in one of these cute little frocks.
Hey! What kind of thing is that for a studly guy like you to be thinking? Get ahold of yourself, fella!
That's not a very clean habit.

All the best-dressed bipedal female fashion slaves shop here at Sock's. The dazzling decor is just eye-numbing enough to make the price tags hard to read. "Wow", you think to yourself, "this place is fancier than Frederick's of Uranus!"
The air is thick with the smell of synthetics.
She said she was busy.
It's a nice outfit, but you're not sure you have the midriff for it.
It doesn't smell great, but it smells better than you.
You lick the mannequin and find that it doesn't please your palate.
Although just a mannequin, it's not intelligent enough to converse with even you.
The skin color and cape make a statement - the kind taken in police stations!
Wow! Genuine Zynthion leather.
Whoaa, baby! Where have you been? Eau de Water Buffalo went out of style epochs ago.
Sorry. No brain.
These wigs are the latest fashion if you have a conehead or like the purple haze look.
Yep. It's synthetic hair.
Would stripes look good on me, you wonder. "Those boots are attractive."
Dragging your tongue across the synthetic hair is almost as enjoyable as running it through a french fry slicer.
No smell.
It's the dressing room door.
These are some darn attractive wigs. Just the thing if you want a head like an ax, or you want to capture that Ed Grimly look.
Yep. It's synthetic hair all right.
Dragging your tongue across the fine strands of of synthetic hair is almost as enjoyable as running it through a french fry slicer.
Hmmm.. they can't be real. No living thing can resist your charm.
Nah. You've never had a taste for stripes.
Aromatic metals, lubricants, and synthetic materials emanate from its general vicinity.
You ask her to dance but get no response. Shot down again.
This store seems to be closed. A security door blocks the entrance.
It's locked down tight. You can't open it.
It smells like the kind of place where unwashed teen-agers stand around smoking, sweating and performing other unmentionable teen-age acts.
It tastes like it smells.
These lights are hypnotic. Maybe they're some of those "subliminal optic stimulators" you've read about. As you gaze into their glare, you become very hungry for sushi.
Why, it's "Buckazoid Bill's Arcade and Sushi Bar."
There's a fresh woodsy, artificial scent coming from the plants.
The aroma is a tasteful melange of pine and potpourri.³
Have some taste, Roger! These are phoney mall plants!
HALT, WILCO!

Max, is that you? Agent 99? I always get these lousy disguises. Would you put a word in with the Chief for me? I wouldn't mind, but all these kids eat is ice cream and candy bars. Do you know how many Big Chewies I've eaten in the last hour? Not to mention the wad of Big Bang BubbleGum I've got stuck to my shoe phone... (sigh!)
That would be most unwise!
Seeing as how these guys are trying to kill you, your best line of defense would be a straight one out of here.
You'd best stay of sight out this guy!
You'd better not. You might need that later.
The Sequel Police are closely monitored by Vohaul. Bribing them would be out of the question.
Even if you were to lasso a Sequel Policeman, what would you do with him?
Try as you might, the gum just gets stuck to your fingers.
He's going to SHOOT you, not write you a ticket!
Gooey, greasy little fingers, and various appendages have left a coating that smells like a cross between cotton candy and dead gerbils.
Auugghh! You had to taste it! Well, it tastes more like dead gerbils than like cotton candy!
Back off. It's not your turn.
The sign says "Ms. Astro Chicken". How strange that nobody is playing it.
Whoa! This game's circuits have melted into a mass of molten silicon. But the fireworks were pretty!
You give the Time Pod a long glance. It resembles an overgrown titanium tennis shoe.
It smells scorched.
It tastes scorched. Oxidized materials now coat your tongue.
It's one of Vohaul's Sequel Policemen!
No way! That would be assault with intent to emit battery!
The Ms. Astro Chicken machine looks as though it's taken its last buckazoid.
You seem to be fresh out of buckazoids.
Your best score on Cap'n Zappo was 251. This kid has... 15,290,912 !?
The GHETTO BLASTER game is completely socially irredeemable, gratuitously violent, and without a doubt the most popular arcade game EVER!
Boy! You'd think after all these years, they'd come up with something more sophisticated than frogs jumping from log to log.
This SLIME FLYER machine has seen better days.
It's some sort of video art form. Looks like a computer-generated fractal simulation of a washing machine.
That's too high for you to reach.
That's too high for you to smell.
That's too high for you to taste.
It's some sort of video art form. Looks like a hand throwing a pizza.
This game; "DWEEB HUNTER" reminds you too much of your present predicament. And guess who the dweeb is!
Gazing at the wastebasket, your impulse - nay, your very instinct - nay, the very fibres of your being - scream out for you to pick up that garbage. But you're too busy.
You resist those inbred custodial tendencies to collect garbage. You have much more important garbage to tend to!
You're quite startled to hear the wastebasket respond...
Give your nose a break! It's a garbage can!
You'd better not throw that away. It'll probably come in handy later. I know it doesn't seem likely, but trust me on this one.
Watching this fine youngster brings back fond memories of your youth. Little did you know that all of those hours playing "BLAZIN' PADDLES" were in preparation for being a space-guy-hero-type.
Leave the kid alone. He's totally engrossed in his game.
Talking to a kid in the middle of an arcade game is almost as interesting as talking to the wall. Give it up.
Walking up to a young, active creature like this one and sniffing it could be considered unusual behavior.
The change machine looks like a time machine more than a time machine looks like a time machine... for a change.
You're not close enough to the change machine to touch it.
A real lady wouldn't try to break a change machine.
Banging on the change machine will only activate its self-defense mechanisms.
In all the known universe, the buckazoid is the lowest denomination of all. You can't get change for it.
The dead fish in the sushi bar machine appear to have been dead far longer than they were fish. The sushi bar was not one of Buckazoid Bill's greatest ideas.
